text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 9. Academic Reference 10.Personal Statement 11.Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. 12.Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).
